input.content: Pattern: premature contract-phase in a dual-shape data migration. A "cleanup" removed the legacy-shape read fallback (e.g. top-level `address` vs nested `destination.address`) while background batched migration was still in progress and no startup gate guaranteed completion. Any unmigrated row raises KeyError, and because list endpoints map over all rows, one legacy row fails the entire listing. Check: when a reader drops a legacy branch, verify migration completion is enforced (gate/precondition), not merely planned; tests seeded only via the new writer will not catch it — require a mixed-shape fixture test. (P1, saved-destinations reader.py, 2026-10-11)
